metadata.description: Live-captured DELETE /api/mdm/profiles/{profileId} against UEM 26.2.0.0, 2026-07-30. Real-wire finding: the response carries X-Api-Version: v1 even though the request Accept header sent version=2 (Api-Supported-Versions echoed only "2" on the create/update calls for this platform, so this looks like DELETE's response labeling is version-invariant rather than a real functional v1/v2 split). Response body is empty (200, Content-Length 0) regardless.
